title: eBay makes selling easier with enhanced camera-first experience
summary: A new magical listing experience leverages AI to create a ready-to-review listing in a few steps.
body_markdown:
Selling on the eBay app is now easier. With next generation magical listing technology, eBay is leveraging AI to transform your photos into a ready-to-review listing.


Here's how it works: Take photos of your item, and eBay automatically identifies it and fills in the listing details. All you have to do is review the draft and hit publish.


Already, more than 10 million unique sellers have used eBay’s AI features to date, creating more than 800,000 new listings every day.


By shifting the work from setup to review, eBay’s new listing experience eliminates manual data entry and takes the guesswork out of selling. While AI powers the creation, you remain completely in control. Nothing goes live without your approval: you can easily review the pre-filled information, make any edits, and decide exactly when your item is ready to list.


The next-generation experience builds on the simplified mobile listing flow eBay introduced last year, using AI to help make listing easier for sellers across the globe.


The new camera-first listing experience is available to sellers in Australia, France, Germany, Italy, the U.K., and the U.S.


Learn more about selling on eBay here:[https://www.ebay.com/help/selling](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling)
